answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 8159 Country: India Title: What to do when i wake up at sahri and i observe i have had night fall and i dont have time for gusul.wt should i do abt sahri,should i have sahri or not? isnt it haram to eat anything without having gusul after passing out semen? i face this problem most often,wt should i do about it? Question: salamalaikum. What to do when i wake up at sahri and i observe i have had night fall and i dont have time for gusul.wt should i do abt sahri,should i have sahri or not? isnt it haram to eat anything without having gusul after passing out semen? i face this problem most often,wt should i do about it? Answer ID: 8159 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1643/1562=D/1429) In the case mentioned above, you should have sahri after rinsing mouth with water and then have a bath soon lest the Fajr Salah is missed. One can eat sahri in the state of janabah (impurity causing obligatory bath), it is not haram . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
